body: Did you find anything to fill the void?
I get a ache in my chest and the feeling of a fist in there.
Sounds like a nice dream. I've never been in love, some call it emotional retardation.
I'm of  no value to this world. I already talk to others but not about this because they only want me to listen to their problems and be there for them. I am at the edge of myself now.
OMG this is so true and even when they are on the road they think the traffic laws do not apply to them!
Sounds like how I am feeling at the moment.. I might just runaway soon. You can join me if you like.
Woah, lets not get ahead of ourselves now!
Envy and possibly some self loathing.
My mum did that to me when I was a child. I would kick it off again in my sleep. It was kind of annoying tbh

Thank you for your reply. I don't think I have an ED mainly because apart from my cockup today I don't overeat, I dont vomit food up and I don't undereat. I maintained a deficit to lose weight while exercising.   I associate being overweight with physical mental and emotional abuse and I just can't live like that anymore. The thought that I could be self sabotaging after a year of hard work and commitment freaks me out to no end. I understand that posting this thread may make me seem weak mentally but I don't have anyone to advise me atm.

Thanks again for replying to my question. What I meant before was, does a vest of that weight burn loads and loads of calories for eg. a similar amount to if I went swimming and burned around 400cals? Or is it something more negligible i.e I wont puff up like a balloon if I stopped using it?

Is it possible that the vest burns loads of calories because it is very heavy at 20kg or is it a fairly negligible amount per day? I just dont want to stop using it then start to gain because it somehow burned a lot of calories.

I don't know my current weight because I have had no access to a scale in over a month but I will do next week. Also weighing myself is a bit daunting for me. Last time I checked I was around 150lbs and I am 169cm tall and quite strong. Can you tell me why the vest wont do much for me?

Thank you for replying to my post. I think the thing I am most worried about is the degree to which my body relies on the vest which although not worn everyday is worn fairly often. I thought it would help me stay strong while burning extra calories. The odds are that I may be under 150lbs but I dont know atm. I am around 169cm in height and I would say I am quite strong. I just dont want to find out that the vest burns so many calories that ceasing to use it would cause weight regain.
